Class SshClientApp

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientApp
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host, SshConnectionPanel.Listener, TerminalSession.Host
public class SshClientApp extends JFrame implements SshConnectionPanel.Listener, TerminalSession.Host, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host
The SshClientApp window is the dark SSH client. JediTerm is the terminal widget inside each pane. The frame holds the FoldingPanel, the SshConnectionPanel, the TerminalSession list, and the AetherisNotebookPanel. Connect and disconnect go through SshSessionController. The window uses the Metal look from SshClientTheme. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshClientApp

  • Constructor Details

    • SshClientApp

      public SshClientApp(SshClientProperties properties, SshClientTheme theme, AetherisYaml yaml)
      The constructor builds the window. A null yaml, or a blank title, uses AetherisYaml.DEFAULT_TITLE. Any other title is trimmed. A null yaml is replaced with a new AetherisYaml. The notebook, the first TerminalSession, and the connection panel are created here. The close operation does nothing until the confirm dialog runs. The SSH tab is enabled. The Aetheris tab starts disabled. The status word starts as est. tokens: 1. The token timer repeats every 200 milliseconds. The resize timer waits 400 milliseconds and does not repeat. The minimum size is 640 by 480. A saved frame that meets a screen is restored. Any other open uses seatOpeningFrame(). A saved maximized flag sets both maximize bits. A stored Aetheris product tab sets restoreAetheris.
      Parameters:
      properties - The persistence store.
      theme - The dark painter.
      yaml - The Aetheris settings. A null value is replaced.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The main method starts the window. printConsoleBanner() runs first. Log4j is initialized from classpath:log4j2-shell.properties. A runtime failure from that initialize is ignored. AetherisYaml.ensureHomeFile() writes the home file when it is absent. AetherisYaml.load(String[]) reads the arguments. SshClientProperties.load() reads the client file. SshClientProperties.saveIfFileMissing() writes a missing file. The theme defaults are installed before the window is created. The window is created and shown on the Swing thread.
      Parameters:
      args - The program arguments. AetherisYaml.load(String[]) reads them.

    • readImportStream

      private String readImportStream(File file, String title)
      The readImportStream method reads an import file in chunks. The chunk size is 8192 bytes. The first 4096 bytes are kept as a sample. A sample that looks binary shows File looks binary. Send a UTF-8 text file. and returns null. The bytes are decoded as UTF-8. Newlines are normalized. An empty text shows File is empty. and returns null. A file longer than MAX_PASTE_CHARS is still returned. A thrown failure shows the notice and returns null. The stream is closed.
      Parameters:
      file - The chosen file.
      title - The dialog title when the file is refused.
      Returns:
      The normalized text, or null when the caller should stop.

    • showPolite

      private boolean showPolite(String title, String message)
      The showPolite method shows an information dialog before a large import. On the Swing thread the dialog runs immediately. Off that thread the call waits until the dialog returns. A failure shows an error notice and returns false. The return is true only after the dialog has been shown.
      Parameters:
      title - The dialog title.
      message - The notice text.
      Returns:
      True when the dialog was shown.

    • readConsoleText

      private String readConsoleText(File file, String title)
      The readConsoleText method reads a whole file for Load File. A binary sample shows File looks binary. Send a UTF-8 text file. and returns null. The bytes are decoded as UTF-8 and the newlines are normalized. An empty text shows File is empty. and returns null. A text longer than MAX_PASTE_CHARS shows the limit and returns null. A thrown failure shows the notice and returns null.
      Parameters:
      file - The chosen file.
      title - The dialog title when the file is refused.
      Returns:
      The normalized text, or null when the caller should stop.

    • looksBinary

      private boolean looksBinary(byte[] raw)
      The looksBinary method rejects a sample that should not be pasted. A null array returns false. An empty array returns false. The sample is at most 4096 bytes. A zero byte returns true. A byte below 9 counts as a control. A byte above 13 and below 32 counts as a control. The sample is binary when the control count times ten is greater than the sample length.
      Parameters:
      raw - The file bytes.
      Returns:
      True when the file should not be pasted.

The SSH tab uses focusedLiveCount(). A managed token count above zero becomes the budget. Otherwise the focused pane's engine word is read. A blank word is ollama.
